name: 0.1.22-alpha
body:
## macOS installation note

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The macOS builds in this release are temporarily unsigned and not notarized. After dragging Nuvio into the Applications folder, try opening it once. If macOS says Apple cannot check Nuvio for malicious software or that the developer cannot be verified, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down to **Security**, click **Open Anyway**, then confirm **Open**.

## What's Changed

* fix(macos): correct malformed app icon by @tapframe (`ab498c93`)
* perf(startup): reduce cold profile launch work by @tapframe (`82310de4`)
* ci(linux): fix flatpak desktop shortcut and metadata by @FeelThePoveR in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/517
* fix(linux): make horizontal wheel and touchpad scrolling work by @ArjunKdaf in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/496
* Improve desktop layouts by @haaihond in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/544
* feat(player): add playback speed modal, icon parity, and hold-to-speed gesture by @quiettinkerer in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/534
* docs: update linux package readme.md by @saimuelbr in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/520
* fix(desktop): stop parsing an empty TorrServer response as JSON by @ArjunKdaf in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/467
* feat(desktop): re-enable low-ram hover-to-play Skia GIF streaming for collection cards by @quiettinkerer in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/355
* feat(player): add volume boost up to 200% by @ThePunpun in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/536
* fix(desktop): remove per-request timeout and clean up partial downloads in updater by @neerajlovecyber in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/539
* Fix updates folder not clearing itself by @ThEgIGN in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/448
* feat(player): mouse wheel and shift keyboard fine seek on progress bar by @quiettinkerer in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/441
* fix(details): adapt scrollbar contrast to backdrop by @ThePunpun in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/549
* fix(desktop): fix player buttons sometimes being unresponsive by @ThEgIGN in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/564
* fix(desktop): inhibit screensaver and screen lock during playback on Linux by @Jalenzzz in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/554
* fix(desktop): restore the window frame and repaint after exiting borderless fullscreen by @quiettinkerer in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/329
* feat(desktop): add floating top bar, collapsible sidebar, and unified navigation styles by @quiettinkerer in https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/pull/567

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioDesktop/compare/0.1.21-alpha...0.1.22-alpha
